items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: Neal would come down there and sit in. And I think I saw him one night give Charlie one of them cigarettes.

ctx.x: And let me see who else. A White trumpet player would come there sometimes, too. I can't think of his name. But a boy named Neal in Kansas City hung around with Charlie Parker all the time. He just followed him (?).
